{{Quote|Let me guess, you took it upon yourself to link yourself to the Upper Bloovatavian Historical Reference Data Bank and download her entire life story into that rusty tin head of yours.|Lando Calrissian mentions Upper Bloovatavia while exaggerating|<ref name="ats">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
'''Upper Bloovatavia''' was a location which [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] claimed had a Historical Reference Data Bank while he exaggerated during a conversation with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had not heard of Upper Bloovatavia before and took Calrissian literally, not understanding the exaggeration.<ref name="ats" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that Upper Bloovatavia was excluded from the ''Atlas'' and subsequent system appendixes due to it being an imaginary place.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_4.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
